title: Tangency of Cuboids
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 10^5; 0 \leq X_{i,1} < X_{i,2} \leq 100; 0 \leq Y_{i,1} < Y_{i,2} \leq 100; 0 \leq Z_{i,1} < Z_{i,2} \leq 100; Cuboids do not have an intersection with a positive volume.; All input values are integers.
